Shitet, Apartament 2+1, Fresk, 146,000 Euro
Karakteristikat e Prones:
– Apartament 2+1
– Fresk
– Rruga Muhamed Deliu, prane Rezidenca 3D
– Pallat i ri me ashensor
– Kati 2
– I mobiluar
– Siperfaqja Bruto 92m²
– Siperfaqja Neto 80m²
– Cmimi 146,000 Euro
Shitet Apartament 2+1, me siperfaqe 92m², i cili ndodhet ne katin e 2 ne nje pallat te ri me ashensor, ne Fresk prane Residences 3D, rruga Muhamed Deliu.
Ka akses te shpejte me rrugen e Dajtit dhe me rrugen e Thesarit. Zona ofron qetesi dhe te gjitha facilitetet si shkolla, kopshte, farmaci, markete, stacione urbani etj.
Apartamenti organizohet ne sallon ndenje, ambient gatimi, ambient ngrenie, 2 dhoma gjumi dhe tualeti.
Apartamenti eshte totalisht i investuar, shtruar me parket dhe shitet i mobiluar.
Disponon certefikate pronesie.
Per me shume informacione ose per nje vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin e agjencise imobiliare!
description_en: For Sale, Apartment 2+1, Fresk, 146,000 Euro Property Features: – Apartment 2+1 – Fresk – Muhamed Deliu Street, near Residence 3D – New building with elevator – Floor 2 – Furnished – Gross Area 92m² – Net Area 80m² – Price 146,000 Euro Apartment 2+1, with area for sale 92m², which is located on the 2nd floor in a new building with an elevator, in Fresk, near Residences 3D, Muhamed Deliu street. There is quick access to Dajti street and Thesari street. The area offers peace and all facilities such as schools, kindergartens, pharmacies, markets, urban stations, etc. The apartment is organized in living room, kitchen, dining room, 2 bedrooms and bathroom. The apartment is fully invested, laid with parquet and sold furnished. It has ownership certificates. For more information or for a visit to the property, contact the number of the real estate agency!
